// diagnostic

E0514

`{name}` never changes, so declare it with `:`

What

`{name}` never changes, so declare it with `:`

Why

`:=` tells the reader the value changes later, but nothing in its scope writes it

Fix

Write `{name}: …` instead of `{name} := …`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0514: tests/ui/E0514_never_written_is_an_error.stderr.

Error [jet.MutableNeverReassigned]: `names` never changes, so declare it with `:`
  --> tests/ui/E0514_never_written_is_an_error.jet:13:5
    |
 13 |     names := [String]{"a"}
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `:=` tells the reader the value changes later, but nothing in its scope writes it
 Fix: Write `names: …` instead of `names := …`
